entries.zh: 没醉；未醉（字形若为『卒』，则指未了、未成）
entries.en: not drunk; sober
entries.notes: 西语词头『no ocurrir lo que de cir』残损且与汉字栏不合，释义据汉字『無醉』与闽南栏；字形疑醉/卒。

entries.zh: 不忘旧；不忘记故交旧友、不忘旧情
entries.en: not to forget one's old friend(s); not to forget old bonds

entries.zh: 不要互相牵扯拖累（相牵拖：互相拉扯牵连）
entries.en: not to drag one another along; not to involve or implicate each other
entries.notes: 西语词头残损难辨（no tener zei nosua nos），释义据汉字『莫相牽拖』与闽南栏。

entries.zh: 不给、不许；不要让（乞：给/让）
entries.en: not to permit; not to give or let (someone)

entries.zh: 不准；不许、不允许
entries.en: not to permit or allow; to forbid

entries.zh: 不能；没法、没有办法
entries.en: cannot; to be unable (by no means)

entries.zh: 过不去；不能通过、通不过；转义『不过』（但是）
entries.en: not able to pass or get through (no pasa); also used as 'but, however'

entries.zh: 拿他没办法；对他无可奈何（毫无办法）
entries.en: to be unable to do anything to him; to be helpless toward him

entries.zh: 对他毫无办法；拿他一点办法也没有
entries.en: to have no means to deal with him; to be utterly unable (to do anything to him)
entries.notes: R栏官话对音残损难解；柰/奈为异体字；释义据汉字『無法伊柰何』与闽南栏。

entries.zh: 睡不好、睡不着；不能入睡（歹困、袂困）
entries.en: not able to sleep; to sleep badly (no poder dormir)
entries.notes: 首字疑歹/又；闽南栏记『歹困、袂困』两读，据西语 no poder dormin(=dormir) 取『睡不着』义。

entries.zh: 不得已；无可奈何、不得不如此
entries.en: cannot but; to have no choice, to be unable to do otherwise (no poder menos)

entries.zh: 更加不能；怎么也不能
entries.en: not to be able in any way; still less to be able

entries.zh: 断产；不再生育、不能分娩（绝产）
entries.en: unable to give birth; to cease bearing children / barren

entries.zh: 小便不通；尿不通（癃闭）
entries.en: unable to urinate; retention of urine

entries.zh: 夜里醒来后再睡不着；整夜不能安睡
entries.en: unable to rest the whole night; to wake and be unable to fall asleep again
entries.notes: 西语词形 desanparar 疑为 descansar（不能安歇）之误；释义据汉字『醒不成困』与闽南栏。

entries.zh: 无尽；没有穷尽、用之不竭
entries.en: not to be finished/exhausted; endless, inexhaustible

entries.zh: 没有分寸；不知轻重分寸、言行失度
entries.en: to have no sense of measure; to lack propriety / not to know where to stop
entries.notes: 西语『no poder contarse』残损，或为 no poder contenerse（不能自持）之义；释义以汉字『無分寸』为准。

entries.zh: 全无；全然没有、一无所有
entries.en: to have nothing at all; to be entirely without

entries.zh: 不能再出世；不会再投生（天主教语境：人死不再转生）
entries.en: cannot be born again; not to be reborn (no puede volver a renacer)

entries.zh: 现在还去不得；暂时走不成
entries.en: he cannot go away for now; not able to leave just yet
entries.notes: 汉字栏『袂將就得』字面组合费解，据西语『No puede irse por agora』定释。

entries.zh: 办不得、办不成；一说分辨不得
entries.en: unable to manage or carry it out; (alt. reading) unable to tell or discern
entries.notes: 西语残损（疑为 no puede saberse/salvarse 之一）；辨、办二字相通，释义含推断。
